text:
Leah (CS): draft: 'Renewal Quickfire Postcard' 1" - a one-pager customers can run before a renewal call. aim: <5 actions, copy-paste configs, and triage steps. feedback?
Vik (CS Ops): love short. propose 4 blocks: smoke, warmup, live tuning, escalation. each block 1 command or config.
Leah (CS): exactly. want it friendly for non-engineers too. include an email snippet they can forward to their infra team.
Noah (SRE): ops-safe bits: recommend client-side capped retries + jitter; prefer resume-on-stream for 2 attempts then fallback. include line: "avoid simultaneous full-tenant prefill at top-of-hour".
Asha (Solutions Eng): two tiny examples to paste:
- prefill (curl):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant":"ACME","keys":["homepage","pricing"]}'
```
- SDK batching one-liner: `{"batch":{"max_delay_ms":40,"max_tokens":1500}}`
Priya (PM): add renewal-risk signals: YELLOW = error_rate >= 2% for 12h OR p95 >= 1.5x SLO for 6h; RED = error_rate >= 3% for 6h OR p95 >= 2x SLO for 4h. map to actions.
Leah (CS): ill include verbatim CS actions:
- GREEN: confirm warmpool + one smoke test
- YELLOW: schedule 30-min enablement + share telemetry link
- RED: immediate war room + consider temporary model downgrade to preserve UX
Vik (CS Ops): caching notes: recommend TTL by churn: high=1h, medium=4h, low=24h. show tiny circuit-breaker rule: "if tenant causes >40% evictions in 1h -> disable shared cache for tenant".
Noah (SRE): streaming fallback flow (text): `stream -> resume x2 -> if fail -> return cached partial + enqueue full gen async (notify webhook)`; add metric keys to request: `prefill.success_rate`, `prefill.latency.p95`, `stream.resume_attempts`.
Asha (Solutions Eng): include a short pasteable Slack customer message they can send us: `@redwood-cs: smoke failed for TENANT123 after warmup. requesting enablement check. dashboard: <link>`
Leah (CS): and a 1-sentence telemetry opt-in they can send to customers: "I agree to share anonymized runtime metrics with Redwood for onboarding help (GDPR consent)." add link to consent template.
Priya (PM): quick recovery play: if RED persists >3h -> route to smaller model variant and schedule postmortem. add suggested wording for CS to use in renewal convo.
OnboardBot: created checklist card -> ID ONB-2026-0042 -> assigned Leah (CS). :robot_face:
Leah (CS): perfect. i'll format into a single-page postcard + an email + a one-click checklist CS can DM. will drop draft in #customer-success tomorrow AM. any last micro-edits? :thumbsup:
